papers.title: Dr. DocBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Expert-Level and Difficult Document Parsing
papers.authors: Minglai Yang, Xinyan Velocity Yu, Pengyuan Li, Xinyu Guo, Zhenting Qi, Konwoo Kim, Longtian Ye, Xiaolong Luo, Jinhe Bi, Henry Zhang, Haris Riaz, Xuan Zhang, Yunze Xiao, Bangya Liu, Tom Tang, Yunfei Zhao, Qunshu Lin, Zihan Wang, Minghao Liu, Michael Lingzhi Li, Yilun Du, Jesse Thomason, Rogerio Feris, Alex Pentland, Zexue He
papers.affiliations: 见第十二节
papers.intro: 本文提出了Dr. DocBench，一个覆盖52个BISAC主题领域、包含4,514页难度感知采样的专家级文档解析基准，通过细粒度页面级和块级标注，系统评估当前最强文档解析系统和通用视觉语言模型，并揭示它们在专业领域和复杂结构上的显著失败。

papers.title: VigilFormer: Deformable Attention for Video Anomaly Detection with Causal Risk Inference
papers.authors: Xinze Zhang
papers.affiliations: University of Southern California, Los Angeles, CA 90007, USA
papers.intro: VigilFormer将可变形时空注意力与因果时序建模统一在同一框架中，并引入自适应置信度跳帧机制，在三个标准WS-VAD基准上以41.5 FPS的实时速度实现了超越现有弱监督方法的AUC性能。

papers.title: CoSTL: Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection
papers.authors: Xin Dong, Wenjia Geng, Wenfeng Deng, Yansong Tang
papers.affiliations: Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University; Pengcheng Laboratory
papers.intro: 提出CoSTL框架，通过文本驱动的渐进式细粒度图像编码器和多尺度时间感知模块，联合学习图像级空间信息与视频级时间动态，在四个公开基准上实现时刻检索和精彩片段检测的最新最先进性能。

papers.title: Dual-Route Top-K Retrieval with 1v1 VLM Reranking for the CoVR-R
papers.authors: Yuyang Sun, Yongliang Wu, Xingyu Zhu, Yuxia Chen, Zhenxiang Jiang, Yangguang Ji, Wenbo Zhu, Yanxi Shi, Jay Wu, Shuo Wang, Xu Yang
papers.affiliations: Southeast University; National University of Singapore; Independent Researcher; Opus AI Research; University of Science and Technology of China
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种零样本的分阶段检索与重排流水线，通过"推理/文本种子路线 + DFN视觉候选路线"构建top-10候选集，再用1v1 VLM最终重排器进行保守的逐对比较，以解耦召回选择和top-1替换决策，在CoVR-R隐藏测试集上取得了95.28 R@1、97.47 R@5、98.48 R@10和9…

papers.title: Reason, Retrieve, Re-rank: A Zero-Shot Reasoning-Aware Framework for Composed Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Ali Alavi
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University
papers.intro: 本文提出R3-CoVR，一个完全由冻结基础模型构成的三阶段零样本训练无关框架，通过“推理-检索-重排”流水线在CoVR-R挑战测试集上将R@1从67.5%提升至91.9%。

papers.title: SuperMemory-VQA: An Egocentric Visual Question-Answering Benchmark for Long-Horizon Memory
papers.authors: Samiul Alam, Shakhrul Iman Siam, Michael J. Proulx, James Fort, Richard Newcombe, Hyo Jin Kim, Mi Zhang
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, video segmentation, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University, Meta
papers.intro: 本文提出了SuperMemory-VQA，一个包含52.9小时多模态自我中心视频和4,853个经过人工验证的问答对的长时记忆VQA基准数据集，用于评估AI助手在真实、长期记忆任务上的表现，并揭示了现有系统在可回答性检测、长时间间隔推理和多证据整合方面的重大不足。

papers.title: GIRL-DETR: Gradient-Isolated Reinforcement Learning for Video Moment Retrieval
papers.authors: Shihang Zhang, Mingjin Kuai, Ye Wei, Zhen Zhang, Wei Ji
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Sichuan University（四川大学）；Nanjing University（南京大学）
papers.intro: GIRL-DETR首次将强化学习后训练引入轻量级视频时刻检索模型，通过梯度隔离策略冻结骨干网络、仅更新检测头，并采用三阶段渐进式RL策略直接优化非可微的tIoU指标，有效解决了代理损失退化问题。

papers.title: Linear Scaling Video VLMs for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Cristobal Eyzaguirre, Jiajun Wu, Juan Carlos Niebles
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, tracking, video search
papers.affiliations: Stanford University
papers.intro: 本文提出StateKV，一种无需微调或架构修改的推理时方法，通过固定容量、基于重要性的循环状态携带跨帧上下文，并配合完整的逐帧缓存用于解码，将预训练长视频VLM的视频预填充复杂度从二次方降至线性，在多个基准和模型上接近全自注意力性能并优于滑动窗口方法。

papers.title: GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Junlong Li, Chao Hao, Lap-Pui Chau, Yi Wang
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: 本文提出GUI-D数据筛选与难度评分管道和GUI-C²粗到细强化学习框架，通过难度感知加权和区域门控的逐步精炼机制，在仅用约4600个训练样本的3B参数模型上实现了SOTA GUI grounding性能，同时大幅简化决策流程、提升推理效率。

papers.title: GMOS: Grounding Moving Object Segmentation in 3D Space and Time
papers.authors: Junyu Xie, Tengda Han, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman
papers.tags: video segmentation, instance segmentation, scene understanding, 3D reconstruction, video search
papers.affiliations: Visual Geometry Group, Department of Engineering Science, University of Oxford, UK; SAI, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, China
papers.intro: 提出GMOS，一个直接从RGB视频输出3D感知、时间精细的多运动物体分割的提议器-传播器框架，同时引入新数据集GMOS-2K和瞬时MOS评估协议MOS-I。

papers.title: AdaState: Self-Evolving Anchors for Streaming Video Generation
papers.authors: Yusuf Dalva, Pinar Yanardag
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Virginia Tech
papers.intro: 提出AdaState，用自适应状态（adaptive state）替换第一帧静态锚点作为场景参考，该状态与视频内容同步去噪但从不渲染，通过注意力机制自我演进，从而在保持场景一致性的同时显著提升视频动态和自然场景过渡。

papers.title: YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective
papers.authors: You-Zhe Xie, Yu-Hsuan Li, Jie-Ying Lee, Kaipeng Zhang, Yu-Lun Liu, Zhixiang Wang
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Shanda AI Research Tokyo
papers.intro: 本文提出YoCausal——一个基于认知科学中“期望违背”范式的两级基准，通过零成本的时间反转操作构造自然反事实样本，利用去噪损失评估VDMs的时间箭头感知（Level 1的RSI）和因果认知能力（Level 2的CCI），揭示了当前先进VDMs在因果理解上与人类存在显著差距，且时间箭头感知并不等价…

papers.title: GPIC: A Giant Permissive Image Corpus for Visual Generation
papers.authors: Keshigeyan Chandrasegaran, Kyle Sargent, Suchir Agarwal, Michael Jang, Michael Poli, Juan Carlos Niebles, Justin Johnson, Jiajun Wu, Li Fei-Fei
papers.affiliations: Stanford University; Radical Numerics; University of Michigan; Salesforce Research
papers.intro: 本文提出GPIC（Giant Permissive Image Corpus），一个约28万亿像素、包含1亿图像-文本对、全部采用许可授权、中央托管于Hugging Face的大规模图像数据集，并提供了相应的基准评估协议和参考基线。

papers.title: REST3D: Reconstructing Physically Stable 3D Scenes from a Single Image
papers.authors: Xiaoxuan Ma, Jiashun Wang, Nicolas Ugrinovic, Yehonathan Litman, Kris Kitani
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University
papers.intro: 提出REST3D框架，通过智能体物理场景理解构建场景树表示，并集成物理约束优化，从单张图像重建视觉一致且物理稳定的3D场景。

papers.title: Colored Noise Diffusion Sampling
papers.authors: Hadar Davidson, Noam Issachar, Sagie Benaim
papers.affiliations: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem
papers.intro: 本文提出Colored Noise Sampling（CNS），一种无需训练、即插即用的随机求解器，通过时间步和频率依赖的彩色噪声注入，主动利用扩散模型的频谱偏置，将有限噪声能量优先分配到尚未被解析的频率频段，从而缩小生成分布与真实数据分布的频谱间隙，显著降低FID。

papers.title: Supercharging Thermal Gaussian Splatting with Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Manoj Biswanath, Chenxin Cai, Hannah Schieber, Daniel Roth, Benjamin Busam
papers.affiliations: 未明确（第一页作者列表未直接列出所属机构，但在正文第一页脚注中标注了各作者所属机构，详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出TDg（Thermal-to-Depth Gaussian Splatting）方法，通过集成从热红外图像估计的深度信息来监督3D高斯泼溅的几何优化，实现仅使用热红外单模态的高效新视角合成，显著缩短训练时间并提升渲染质量。

papers.title: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
papers.authors: Shihao Han, Hao Yang, Xinting Hu, Xiaofeng Mei, Yi Jiang, Xiaojuan Qi
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: ByteDance Inc., The University of Hong Kong, University of Science and Technology of China
papers.intro: Veda通过蒸馏全注意力的图块级结构，提出显式图块选择框架，结合统计感知评分和头部感知图块划分，在视频扩散模型中实现5.1倍端到端加速且不牺牲生成质量。

papers.title: City-Mesh3R: Simulation-Ready City-Scale 3D Mesh Reconstruction from Multi-View Images
papers.authors: Sayan Paul, Sourav Ghosh, Siddharth Katageri, Soumyadip Maity, Sanjana Sinha, Brojeshwar Bhowmick
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, point cloud, NeRF, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Visual Computing & Embodied AI Lab, TCS Research, India
papers.intro: 提出一个分布式端到端流水线City-Mesh3R，通过分治策略从无序图像直接重建水密、可仿真的城市级3D网格，包括拓扑图像聚类、分布式SfM、空间划分、几何感知相机选择、自适应密度网格优化与缝合。

papers.title: Not All Inputs Are Valid: Towards Open-Set Video Moment Retrieval Using Language
papers.authors: Xiang Fang, Wanlong Fang, Daizong Liu, Xiaoye Qu, Jianfeng Dong, Pan Zhou, Renfu Li, Zichuan Xu, Lixing Chen, Panpan Zheng, Yu Cheng
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Peking University, Zhejiang Gongshang University, Dalian University of Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Xinjiang University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文首次提出开放集视频时刻检索（OS-VMR）任务，并设计了一个名为OpenVMR的框架，利用归一化流技术学习ID查询分布、推理ID-OOD分离边界，并基于ID查询进行跨模态交互和时刻检索，实现对OOD查询的拒绝和ID查询的准确检索。

papers.title: Fewer Steps, Better Performance: Efficient Cross-Modal Clip Trimming for Video Moment Retrieval Using Language
papers.authors: Xiang Fang, Daizong Liu, Wanlong Fang, Pan Zhou, Zichuan Xu, Wenzheng Xu, Junyang Chen, Renfu Li
papers.tags: video search, video segmentation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学（Hubei Engineering Research Center on Big Data Security, School of Cyber Science and Engineering）、北京大学、河南大学、大连理工大学、四川大学、深圳大学
papers.intro: 本文提出SpotVMR，一种基于查询条件化的高效视频片段选择方法，通过轻量级BAM语义索引特征和递归片段选择机制，仅对少量查询相关片段进行昂贵的跨模态交互，在显著提升推理效率的同时保持甚至提升VMR检索性能。
